mapper.select: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM RECEIVED_AT) AS "month", COUNT(*) AS "received", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "done", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DONE' AND (DEADLINE_AT IS NULL OR COMPLETED_AT <= DEADLINE_AT) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "onTime" FROM CIVIL_COMPLAINT WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM RECEIVED_AT) = #{year} GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM RECEIVED_AT) ORDER BY 1

SELECT KIND AS "kind", COUNT(*) AS "received", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "done", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DONE' AND (DEADLINE_AT IS NULL OR COMPLETED_AT <= DEADLINE_AT) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "onTime", SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(EXTEND_COUNT, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "extended" FROM CIVIL_COMPLAINT WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM RECEIVED_AT) = #{year} GROUP BY KIND ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT B.DEPT_NAME AS "dept", SUM(B.AMOUNT) AS "budget", NVL(SUM(U.USED), 0) AS "used" FROM FIN_BUDGET B LEFT JOIN (SELECT BUDGET_ID, SUM(AMOUNT) AS USED FROM FIN_TXN WHERE CANCELLED_YN = 'N' GROUP BY BUDGET_ID) U ON U.BUDGET_ID = B.BUDGET_ID WHERE B.KIND = 'EXP' AND B.FISCAL_YEAR = #{year} AND B.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND B.DELETED_YN = 'N' GROUP BY B.DEPT_NAME ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT STATUS AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "cnt", SUM(CASE WHEN NOTIFIED_ON IS NOT NULL AND NOTIFIED_ON <= DEADLINE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "onTime" FROM WELFARE_CASE WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM APPLIED_ON) = #{year} GROUP BY STATUS
SELECT RESULT AS "result", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM HYGIENE_CHECK WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CHECKED_ON) = #{year} GROUP BY RESULT

SELECT KIND AS "kind", STATUS AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "cnt", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'VALID' AND START_DEADLINE < #{today, jdbcType=DATE} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "overdue" FROM BUILDING_CASE GROUP BY KIND, STATUS

SELECT R.KIND AS "kind", COUNT(*) AS "cnt", NVL(SUM(R.DAYS), 0) AS "days", NVL(SUM(R.HOURS), 0) AS "hours" FROM DUTY_REQUEST R JOIN APPROVAL_DOC D ON D.DOC_ID = R.DOC_ID WHERE D.STATUS = 'DONE' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM R.START_DATE) = #{year} GROUP BY R.KIND
